name: Popover
description: A compound popover component built on @radix-ui/react-popover. Provides Popover (root), PopoverTrigger, PopoverAnchor, and PopoverContent sub-components. Content is rendered through a portal with animated enter/exit transitions.

props.name: Popover (Root)
props.description: Wrapper component. Accepts open, onOpenChange, defaultOpen, and modal from Radix Popover.Root.

props.name: PopoverTrigger
props.description: The interactive element that toggles the popover open/closed. Supports asChild to compose with custom trigger elements.

props.name: PopoverAnchor
props.description: An optional anchor element that the popover content is positioned relative to, when different from the trigger.

props.name: PopoverContent.className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with the default content styles via cn().

props.name: PopoverContent.align
props.description: The preferred alignment of the content relative to the trigger or anchor.

props.name: PopoverContent.sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels between the content and the trigger/anchor.

props.name: PopoverContent...props
props.description: All additional Radix Popover.Content props are forwarded (side, sideOffset, alignOffset, avoidCollisions, etc.).

accessibility.role: Managed by Radix Popover primitive. The trigger receives aria-expanded and aria-controls attributes.
accessibility.keyboard: Enter/Space toggles the popover. Escape closes it. Focus is trapped inside the content when open.
accessibility.aria: Radix handles aria-expanded, aria-controls, and aria-haspopup automatically. Content is rendered in a portal for proper stacking.
accessibility.notes: Content includes animated fade and zoom transitions on open/close, and directional slide-in animations based on placement side (top, bottom, left, right). Default width is w-72.
